_comment: Detailed Room View (click a room in the house). 'rooms' enables an interior per room type and says how creators are staged there; rooms not listed keep the house view only. 'sit_anims' maps a creator's simulated animation to a seated pose when a seat is free and she can sit (painted creators need a painted sitting pose); everyone else is shown at her simulated spot doing her real activity. 'seating' derives seats from furniture kinds in rooms.json: seat_h = seat height (fraction of the room's interior height), seats = fixed count, or seat_spacing (fraction of room width) with margin (fraction of the item's width kept for armrests). Room View never changes game state.
